general.label: General analogue
general.rationale: Equal weight on every available criterion.

rover.label: Rover mobility
rover.rationale: Traversability is governed mainly by slope and roughness at the ~1 km baseline; climate is secondary.

eva.label: EVA training
eva.rationale: Crew exposure: dryness, thermal swings and walkable terrain.

thermal.label: Thermal testing
thermal.rationale: Hardware thermal cycling: diurnal surface swing and seasonal air-temperature range dominate.

habitat.label: Habitat operations
habitat.rationale: Long-duration stays: thermal environment plus low slope for construction.

instrument.label: Science instrument testing
instrument.rationale: Dry surfaces and thin (high) atmosphere columns matter most for instrument analogues.

criteria.label: Aridity
criteria.description: UNEP-style aridity index P/PET. PET by Hargreaves (1985) from NASA POWER T2M, T2M_MAX_AVG, T2M_MIN_AVG with FAO-56 extraterrestrial radiation Ra (computed from latitude); P = PRECTOTCORR. Values >= 1 (energy-limited, humid) are saturated at 1. Missing where Hargreaves PET is undefined.

criteria.label: Annual temperature range
criteria.description: Warmest-month minus coldest-month mean 2 m air temperature (NASA POWER T2M climatology 2001-2020).

criteria.label: Elevation
criteria.description: Mean GMTED2010 30-arc-second elevation in the cell (m above EGM96).

criteria.label: Slope
criteria.description: Mean Horn (1981) slope on a 926.6 m baseline.

criteria.label: Surface roughness
criteria.description: Standard deviation of 926.6 m-baseline elevations inside the cell.

criteria.label: Thermal (LST diurnal range)
criteria.description: MODIS Aqua land-surface temperature at ~13:30 minus ~01:30 local solar time, mean of monthly composites 2016-2025.
